# SPD-015 — Hold a lead that returns with its own children unrecorded

## Brief
Law 9 binds every parent, but after [[SPD-008]] the `Stop` hook covers Spud's turn only: a lead can return `done` while a child it spawned has a final stop recorded and no `outcome`, and nothing holds it. Extend the `SubagentStop` hold in `bin/spud` so a member whose own children have `stopped_at` set and no `outcome` is held once with the list ("record each with `spud --as <id> member finish …`"), the same shape as the Result hold and the Law 9 block, `stop_hook_active` letting the second pass through. Evidence: Desiree's proposal 1 on [[SPD-008]] (`hook_stop` lists members whose parent is Spud or no longer alive; `hook_subagent_stop` checks only the member's own `result`/`blocked`).

Done when: a red-first test in `tests/test_hooks.py` shows the hold once and the release, the suite stays green, and a headless probe with a lead and one background child shows the lead held until it finishes the child.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer. **Tier override: fable instead of opus.** Reason: enforcement, same as SPD-008; a hold that fails open is silent.
